name: Swamp Milkweed
desc: Swamp Milkweed (Asclepias incarnata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias incarnata, the swamp milkweed, rose milkweed, rose milkflower, swamp silkweed, or white Indian hemp, is a herbaceous perennial plant species native to North America.
